duration.text: The Chinese Language at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: ●Student Affirmations signed by the applicant (template can be downloaded on BFSU system)●Copy of diploma/pre-graduation certificateIf the original is not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation should be attached.●Copy of transcript of academic recordIf the original is not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation should be attached.●Photocopy of the HSK certificateApplicants with HSK Level 4 (180 or above) are preferred.●Copy of the first page of valid ordinary passport●Visa page (only for applicants who are studying at local schools in China currently)●Application Form for Chinese Government ScholarshipThe form can be downloaded after the applicant submits the application information online via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System.●Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (template can be downloaded on BFSU system; Must be completed in English. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months.)●Non-criminal Record Report (template can be downloaded on BFSU system; Certification documents issued within 6 months prior to the application date.)●Other supporting materials, including letters of recommendation or certificates of awards (not compulsory)

requirements.text: 1. Hold citizenship from New Zealand, Australia, Cook Islands, Tonga, Fiji, Samoa, Papua New Guinea, Vanuatu, Niue and other countries in the South Pacific region. Proficiency in the Māori language is an advantage.2. Applicants should be foreign citizens holding valid ordinary passports without Chinese nationality as per the Nationality Law of the Peoples Republic of China;3. Applicants’ age range: 18-25;4. Applicants should be high school graduates with a good academic record;5. A minimum score of 180 in HSK Level 4 is required. Applicants who do not meet this standard may enroll in the preparatory program (foundation studies) as specified, with scholarship coverage including preparatory tuition fees.6. Applicants should be physically healthy and meet the physical examination requirements for a Chinese visa or the Residence Permit;7. Applicants should have no records of anti-regulation, anti-public security, or anti-law behaviors. Applicants should be pro-China, have upright conduct, abide by Chinese laws and BFSU’s regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people.8. Applicants should also meet the requirements specified in the 2025 Admission Guide for International Students of Beijing Foreign Studies University.
